en: The postcard front shows a busy street lined with historic multi‑story buildings in a European city. The central focus is an ornate late‑19th‑century facade with balconies and decorative stonework; on its pediment is the inscription "NÁDOR SZÁLLÓ". Pedestrians, cars, and delivery trucks move along the street, and shop signs are visible at street level. Hills rise in the background behind the buildings. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with printed address lines and information about Hotel Nádor in Pécs, Hungary.
